name: Sejdullah
text:
the ladders r still on the van n the drills need charging b4 tomoz, plz sort the pads n pop the keys back in the box, cheers,
Sejdullah

name: Kosovic
text:
the paint tins in the garage r nearly empty n the brushes werent rinsed, plz grab a new tin n some sheets from the shop b4 the weekend, the roller handles r in the shed, cheers,
Kosovic

name: Tenam Zuffellato
text:
the gazebo came back with a bent leg n the side panel is ripped so we cant use it for the fete, plz chase the cricket club for the pegs, the stall holders need the layout by thursday n the bunting is still with the school, the floats r in the tin in the office, cheers,
Tenam Zuffellato

name: Brand Pizurica Bienwald
text:
the spare helmets r in the cage n the track pump is missing, plz bring the torque wrench n the red tape b4 the ride, cheers,
Brand Pizurica Bienwald

name: Kolzok
text:
the display boards r down in the foyer n the posters need swapping for the spring ones, plz put the old ones in the store n check the easels r in the cupboard, the markers r all dried out, cheers,
Kolzok

name: Semenova
text:
the induction packs for the new starters r printed but the lanyards havent arrived yet, plz chase the order, the desks r booked for the morning n the it guy is coming at 10 to set the laptops up, the door codes go in the welcome email so dont share them early, cheers,
Semenova

name: Ben Jeddou
text:
the squash courts r booked for tuesday n the balls r flat again, plz bring a new tube n your own racket, cheers,
Ben Jeddou

name: Podlaszewski Csáki
text:
the loose tiles by the pool r getting worse n the grout is coming out, plz ask the contractor for a date n keep the area taped off, the pump room key is with the life guard n the signs need reprinting, cheers,
Podlaszewski Csáki

name: Sagunthala
text:
the recycling bins r overflowing again n the collection was missed on monday, plz ring the council n get a date for the special pickup, the cardboard is stacked in the yard n needs breaking down b4 the rain comes back, the notice about the new rules is on the board, cheers,
Sagunthala

name: Noreisch
text:
the till in the cafe keeps jamming n the card reader is slow, plz log a call with the supplier n use the back one for now, cheers,
Noreisch

name: Inderwies Karlen
text:
the pond filter is clogged n the fish r up at the surface, plz clean it out n top the water up b4 the weekend, the net is on the hook n the food is in the tin, cheers,
Inderwies Karlen

name: Vinko Strzedulla
text:
the workshop heater tripped the fuse again n the lights flickered when it came on, plz get the sparky to look at the circuit b4 the cold snap, the spare heater is in the store but it needs a new plug, the fire extinguisher check is due too so ask him while hes here, cheers,
Vinko Strzedulla

name: Anghelina
text:
The poolside bins were emptied and the wet floor signs were put away before the evening session. The lane ropes came in and two worn floats were swapped. Thanks,
Anghelina

name: Muscas
text:
The delivery ramp was swept and the grit bin was refilled at both entrances. The handrails were wiped down and the walkway signs were straightened. The cracked paving slab was coned off and added to the repair list for the grounds team. Thanks,
Muscas

name: Michalina Roukaya
text:
The meeting room screens were checked before the hybrid session and the spare dongle was moved to the small room. The whiteboard pens were replaced and the flip chart paper was topped up. The room booking sheet was updated for the room move and the calendar invite was sent to the remote attendees. Thanks,
Michalina Roukaya

name: Màrcia Munirah
text:
The notice boards were refreshed with the new timetables and the old posters went for recycling. The lobby clock was set to the right time. Thanks,
Màrcia Munirah

name: Mizuki
text:
The trolley of refreshments was taken round the ward before the shift handover and the cups were washed afterwards. The empty bottles were bagged for recycling. The water jugs were refreshed and two were swapped for the ones with lids. Thanks,
Mizuki

name: Garcia
text:
The depot keys were checked against the sign out sheet and all but one fob came back. The missing fob belongs to the night van and was logged with the supervisor for a replacement. The yard gates were locked at the usual time and the lighting was checked on the walk round. Thanks,
Garcia

name: Vimalachandran Charles-Antoine
text:
The play equipment was wiped down and the sand pit was covered for the evening. The gate latch was tightened and the notice was rehung. Thanks,
Vimalachandran Charles-Antoine

name: Taglioli Mouralinho
text:
The laundry cages were returned to the basement and the trolley brakes were checked. Two dryers had lint traps cleaned and the filter log was signed for the week. The ironing station was restocked and the spares shelf was tidied. Thanks,
Taglioli Mouralinho

name: Uthayakumari
text:
The storeroom was reorganised over the weekend and the overstock was moved to the top shelves. The bin cards were updated to match and three damaged boxes were rehoused. The hand truck was serviced and a new wheel kit was fitted after the wobble was reported. The aisle markers were reprinted and put back after the paint dried. Thanks,
Uthayakumari

name: Peyrat
text:
The bench slats were sanded and the loose bolts on the picnic tables were tightened. The playhouse door was rehung and the bark was raked level. Thanks,
Peyrat

name: Sarkar Govinda
text:
The sample trays were labelled and returned to the cold room after the tasting. The chopping boards were sanitised and the knives went through the dishwasher. The allergen cards were printed and put at the front of the folder. Thanks,
Sarkar Govinda

name: Arzan Vontz
text:
The hostel common room was cleared after the games night and the tables were wiped and stacked. The kitchen was checked and the fridge was wiped out with the date labels refreshed. The night warden was briefed on the broken window latch and the room list was updated for the new arrivals. Thanks,
Arzan Vontz

name: Shkumbim
text: Shkumbim the trailer lights r playing up again so plz check the plug n the earth wire b4 friday, the straps r in the box, ta

name: Konle
text: Konle can u sort the paint order for the fences cuz the tin we opened is the wrong shade n the undercoat has gone thick, the brushes r in the shed n the sheets r by the door, ta

name: Ashvinth Kellan
text: Ashvinth Kellan the minibus service is booked for monday n the tyres were done last week so just check the fluids, the first aid kit needs a top up n the fire extinguisher tag expires next week, plz grab the spare bulbs from the shelf, the keys go back to the office after

name: Taima Stagljar
text: Taima Stagljar the quiz packs r ready n the prizes r wrapped, can u print the answer sheets n bring the bell, the sound system is sorted, ta

name: Blerentina
text: Blerentina the room booking sheet is missing the thursday slot cuz the yoga group moved, can u confirm the new time n email the warden, the keys r at the desk n the alarm code is the usual one

name: Musiari
text: Musiari the shed clean out is half done n the skip goes back friday so plz get the last of the tins sorted, the tyres n the old paint r on the banned list for the tip run so leave those n the bench, the tools r in the crate n the drill bits came back, ta

name: Carl-Johan Danik
text: Carl-Johan Danik the loo roll n soap r low again in the west block, plz restock from the cupboard n sign the sheet, ta

name: Safeer Piticco
text: Safeer Piticco the fire panel is showing a fault on zone 3 n the engineer cant come till thursday, plz put a watch on it n log the checks at each shift, the key for the panel box is in the office safe, ta

name: Zaheer
text: Zaheer the summer fete stall list is nearly full n two people dropped out overnight so plz fill the gaps, the tables r booked from the scout hut n the bunting is in the loft, we still need a gazebo for the cake stand n the pa system needs testing b4 saturday, the cash tin stays in the office

name: Nguy
text: Nguy the venue has moved to the leisure centre so plz update the invites n the map, parking is the same, ta

name: Bats Puleo
text: Bats Puleo the benches by the pond need a second coat n the paint tin is on the shelf, can u check the weather n pick a dry morning, the brushes r wrapped in the cloth n the turps is in the tin, ta

name: Editta Antonela
text: Editta Antonela the hoist service is booked for tuesday morning n the engineer needs the plant room open, plz meet him with the keys n sign the permit, the log book is on the shelf n the spare slings r in the cupboard, the battery charger for the spare hoist was swapped so it stays on the trolley, ta

name: Modrusan
text: Modrusan the windows upstairs r stuck again so plz book the joiner n leave a note for the tenants, the hinges were oiled last month, ta

name: Délina
text: Délina completed the stock rotation and moved the short dated items to the front. She recorded the temperatures on the sheet and flagged a failing seal on the middle door. The replacement gasket was ordered and the delivery note went to the office.

name: Raica
text: Raica ran the end of day check on the pumps and reconciled the readings. Two nozzles were replaced after the drip test failed and the padlocks were swapped for the new set. The forecourt was swept and the bins were emptied before the delivery arrived. The duty sheet was signed and left for the morning team.

name: do Outeiro
text: do Outeiro logged the pool readings and adjusted the chlorine dose. The filters were backwashed and the skimmer baskets were emptied. The daily sheet was completed and filed.

name: Cejka Ahoya
text: Cejka Ahoya carried out the monthly check on the fire doors and found two that were not closing fully. The closers were adjusted and the doors were retested until they latched cleanly. The findings were noted in the register and the landlord was informed.

name: Hamdija
text: Hamdija walked the boundary fence after the high winds and cleared a branch from the north corner. She found two strained posts and braced them until the fencer can attend. The gate at the lower field was rehung on new hinges. The repairs were logged and the grazier was told about the temporary fixes.

name: Makhmudov
text: Makhmudov tested the emergency lighting and swapped four batteries. All fittings came on when the test button was pressed. The log was updated and the results were filed.

name: Hatiqe Verploegh
text: Hatiqe Verploegh prepared the sample room for the audit and laid out the certificates. The missing calibration sheet was found in the archive and copied into the file. She rechecked the labelling on the shelves and corrected four entries in the register.

name: Nicco Cocimarov
text: Nicco Cocimarov serviced the two club mowers and sharpened the blades on the bench grinder. The fuel cans were topped and the mix was labelled for the two stroke. One spindle bearing has play and was noted for replacement at the next service. The workshop was swept and the tools were put back on the board.

name: Gionni
text: Gionni took the readings from the sub meters and updated the spreadsheet. Two faulty sensors were swapped and the wiring to the panel was checked. The cabinet was resealed.

name: Izair
text: Izair cleared the fallen leaves from the ramp and checked the drainage channel was running free. The handrails were wiped and the grit bin was refilled for the cold snap. Two lights on the walkway were out and the bulbs were replaced from the store.

name: Ben Slimane
text: Ben Slimane inspected the food store and rotated the stock. The chiller was checked and the door seals were wiped down. Two crates of overripe fruit were removed and the wastage was recorded on the sheet. The mousetraps were inspected and the bait boxes were restocked where needed. The storeroom floor was swept and the spill powder was replaced.

name: Jeyavathany Maïka
text: Jeyavathany Maïka reset the tills and counted the floats. The card machine was tested and the rolls were swapped. The safe drop was witnessed and the keys were locked away.

name: Diliet
text: Diliet checked the calendar against the bookings and moved two double booked slots. The deposit records were reconciled and the outstanding balances were flagged. Three enquiries were answered and the follow ups were scheduled. The counter was cleared and the day sheet was closed.
